empresa.lema: An industrial solutions integrator in Mexico's Bajío region: recycling, packaging, supplies, logistics and services, through a single point of contact.
empresa.descripcion: We are an integrator company created to deliver solutions to industry in the Bajío region. Through our network of certified local suppliers and strategic alliances, we bring together in a single business relationship what your company currently buys from many.
empresa.titular: One supplier for everything your plant needs

modelo.titulo: One supplier. An entire network working for your company.
modelo.intro: Sourcing supplies and services for a plant means onboarding, evaluating and coordinating dozens of suppliers. As an integrator, we do that work for you: your purchasing team deals with a single supplier, and we coordinate our network of manufacturers, specialists and partners across the region.

flujo.texto: One request, one purchase order, one contact
We quote, coordinate, deliver and invoice
Certified local suppliers and strategic partners

beneficios.texto: No need to register, evaluate and follow up with multiple suppliers.
Quotes, orders and deliveries across categories handled by one team.
A formal business relationship with proper invoicing and paperwork.
Our own fleet, scheduled pickups and deliveries, and warehouse space.
Zero-landfill recycling and reuse processes that strengthen your corporate image.
Bajío suppliers with the responsiveness and proximity your operation needs.

aliados.titulo: We team up with local businesses
aliados.texto: We bring small and mid-sized regional companies into our network and give them logistics, financial and documentation support so they can serve large corporations. This is how we connect local talent with industry, with the formality your purchasing team requires.
aliados.cta: Are you a local supplier? Join our network
